text:
Priya S.: Quick Q 1 1 I'm on parental leave now but currently on an international assignment (on a UK visa). Partner's medical situation means we might fly back to the US for 8 weeks; does that affect my leave pay, FMLA eligibility, or visa status? Also we might ask for a short unpaid extension.

Sofia (People Ops): Thanks for flagging Priya 497. Short answers: statutory/local leave rules depend on country (UK vs US). Paid parental top-up from Redwood follows the country of payroll and employment contract. If your employment remains with Redwood UK payroll while you're abroad, UK rules apply. We'll loop Legal (Immigration) + Global Mobility.

Legal (Immigration): Hi Priya 310. Moving temporarily to the US can have immigration implications. If you're not authorized to work in the US, you can't resume full duties there. Short visits for family care are usually fine, but working (even part-time) may require work authorization. Please don't take on operational work in the US without clearance.

Priya S.: OK — so I can travel and be on leave, but not work while physically in the US unless cleared? Got it. If I need an unpaid extension, will my benefits continue?

Sofia (People Ops): Benefits continuity depends on payroll and contract. Paid parental leave will continue per the country rules. If you switch to unpaid extension, some benefits (medical, pension) may require company-paid coverage or employee opt-in. We'll get exact terms for UK payroll.

Ari (Payroll): For country of payroll: if you're on Redwood UK payroll during leave, parental top-up follows UK schedule and will be paid in GBP. If we need to temporarily move you to US payroll, that triggers tax and benefits changes and needs a formal mobility action. If you request unpaid extension, we log the break; payroll will show pro-rated accruals.

Global Mobility: Hi Priya 4b6. Please submit the Mobility Intention form: https://intranet.redwood/mobility/intention. In the form, mark "temporary return for family care" and attach travel dates. We'll assess payroll, tax, and immigration risk and get back in 3 business days.

Priya S.: Thanks. Any paperwork sample I should use when I ask for an unpaid extension and travel?

Sofia (People Ops): Use this snippet in the leave amendment form (copy/paste):

```
Subject: Leave amendment - temporary travel to US + unpaid extension
Message: Requesting to temporarily travel to the US while on paid parental leave from 2026-07-05 to 2026-08-30. Request an unpaid extension of 4 weeks following current paid leave. Purpose: family medical care. Please advise on payroll, benefits continuity, and immigration constraints. Manager: Connor. Mobility/Immigration: please advise.
```

Legal (Immigration): Also include passport/visa copies in the mobility form if you want a quicker check. If you plan any work (emails, on-call), mark "no work" and we'll evaluate. Off-record small messages to the team are fine; formal work requires clearance.

Priya S.: If I did a partial return while in the US (like 20% check-ins), is that allowed?

Legal (Immigration): Even incidental operational work can be considered "work" under US rules. We advise no substantive work while physically in the US without US work authorization. Check with Mobility + Legal first.

Ari (Payroll): Tax note: if we end up processing any pay while you're physically in the US, you may create US tax residency triggers. That's why we prefer no payroll moves unless necessary. Mobility will flag tax exposure.

Global Mobility: We'll run a quick payroll/immigration risk assessment once you submit the form. Expect a reply with recommended options: (A) stay on UK payroll and remain on leave while traveling; (B) temporary payroll transfer with tax equalization (rare for short trips); (C) unpaid extension with benefits opt-in.

Priya S.: Great, submitting the mobility form now and putting "no work" in the amendment. Thanks folks 64f.

Sofia (People Ops): Thanks Priya 49b. Ping us if you need a template email to manager or receipts for benefits opt-in.

Global Mobility: Received the form. We'll queue the assessment and loop Legal + Payroll.

Ari (Payroll): FYI Priya 4dd if you later request any stipend or top-up payout while abroad we'll need approvals and tax guidance in advance.

Priya S.: Noted. Appreciate the quick help.
_notes: Thread about international assignment during parental leave: visa/work-authorization constraints, payroll country effects, unpaid extension, mobility form link, sample amendment snippet. Slack-style short replies and action items.
